home.title: Booksy
home.description: Trilingual, paid appointment booking — set your hours, share a link, get booked and paid automatically.

hero.heading: Scheduling that just works.
hero.subheading: Share a link, let clients pick a time, get paid automatically. Booksy handles time zones, reminders, and Stripe payments so you don't have to.

features.heading: Everything you need to take bookings

payments.title: Get paid instantly
payments.description: Secure checkout via Stripe. Funds land in your account the moment a client books a paid service.

timezones.title: Time zones handled for you
timezones.description: Every client sees times in their own time zone, correctly converted — including across daylight saving changes.

languages.title: Trilingual out of the box
languages.description: Your booking page and every email reads in English, French, or Spanish, matching each client automatically.

reminders.title: Automatic reminders
reminders.description: Confirmation and reminder emails go out on their own, with a calendar file attached — no manual follow-up.

showcase.heading: See it in action
showcase.bookingCaption: Clients pick a time and pay in a few clicks.
showcase.dashboardCaption: You see every booking, and can cancel with one click.

cta.heading: Ready to start taking bookings?
cta.body: Set your availability, share your link, and let Booksy handle the rest.

terms.title: Acceptable Use Policy
terms.intro: Booksy is a platform for booking legitimate, lawful services. By listing or booking a service, you agree to the terms below.
terms.prohibitedIntro: Hosts may not use Booksy to sell, advertise, or arrange access to anything illegal, including but not limited to:
terms.prohibitedItem1: Narcotics, controlled substances, or drug paraphernalia
terms.prohibitedItem2: Firearms, ammunition, explosives, or other weapons
terms.prohibitedItem3: Any other goods or services that are illegal under applicable law
terms.enforcementBody: Any account found offering, promoting, or facilitating the sale of illegal items or services will be suspended and permanently removed, without notice or refund. Booksy may also report such activity to law enforcement where required or appropriate.
terms.scopeNote: Booksy is built for booking time-based appointments and services — not for listing or shipping physical goods. Every service must describe a legitimate, bookable offering.
